task.description: The title of the task, for example "(Task) 743 Shard Invocations".

report.description: The report that the task made, for example "(Report) 031 Title". Set it in the report step.

steps.title: Task Work
steps.next: Implement {{task}}: tick each checkbox, write the Task Log, and commit the WIP of each repo in git-repos.

steps.title: Report
steps.next: Make a report when {{task}} asks for one, or when the work found something to keep. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} report="(Report) NNN Title". Else skip this step: flint shard step skip report --reason "<why>".

steps.title: Task Review
steps.next: Set {{task}} to review, give the person a summary, and refine it until the person confirms.

steps.title: Close
steps.next: When the person confirms, run flint shard proj task-close {{task}}. When the session ends with the task, use flint orbh close --with task-confirm instead.

behaviours.say: {{task}} is in review. Close with --with task-confirm to move it to done, or keep it in review.
{{task}} is still open: it is not in review. Move it to review when the work is done, or return with --with task-defer="<reason>" to defer it.
